facts.text: Ingrid is brewing a sleeping potion with the faun wine Dunk gave her, which Dunk plans to help her give to Warwick so he stays asleep while they are inside his house. Dunk heavily diluted the faun wine, about one part in five, with tavern wine.
facts.uncertain_reason: Dunk diluted the faun wine to about 20%, and Father William claims Ingrid can't make her potions herself, so whether the potion will work is unclear.

classification.support_basis: A sleeping Warwick would let Dunk get inside and at the mithril chain shirt without waking him, though the diluted wine and doubts about Ingrid's skill leave its strength uncertain.
classification.action_basis: Ingrid agreed to make the potion and is working on it with the wine Dunk supplied; Dunk is to return to her to carry the plan out.
classification.opening_basis: Ingrid is brewing a sleeping potion; dosing Warwick lets the party enter his house while he sleeps, an advantage beyond simply going for the armor.

facts.resource_subject: Ingrid's sleeping potion made with faun wine

facts.text: Dunk is to return to Ingrid's shop to meet her and help her get into Warwick's house and give him the sleeping potion, so she can watch him sleep without fear of waking him.

classification.stake_basis: Ingrid agreed to brew the potion on Dunk's proposal that he would help her get it to Warwick so she could watch him all night, and she cannot reach the windowsill easily herself.

facts.text: Can Ingrid really make her potions herself, as she claims, or is Father William right that she can't?

classification.grounding_justification: Father William's claim and Ingrid's direct contradiction clearly raise the question.
classification.investigative_depth_justification: The answer is mostly a fact about her skill, though it may touch on her ties to Vivian and the coven.
classification.narrative_payoff_justification: Mainly instrumental: whether the potion works.
classification.investigative_potential_justification: Seeing the potion's effect would largely settle it.
